ops.title: Migrate fleet stores to cc-transcript v14.5 ASYNC composition (cc-steer composition, captain-hook async end-to-end)

ops.description:
DIRECTION REVERSED by the user on 2026-07-19: the store tier goes natively ASYNC — shipping as v14.5.0 (version renumbered from 14.3: a concurrent session released 14.3.0/14.4.0 for codex parsing + the MCP tool-spec registry while the async wave was in flight). The previous async→sync framing of this task is dead; do NOT execute the old sync migration.

v14.5.0 ships: mining.FeedbackStore as a final ASYNC composition facade (frozen StoreSchema config unchanged in shape; `async with store.transaction()`; every method awaitable; `await FeedbackStore.open(...)` + `async with store:`); CorrectionLog async (+ new close/async CM); DecisionLog/HeartbeatLog async (stdlib ConnectionActor, Go co-writer DDL bytes unchanged); Watcher async tick + stream. TransactionConflictError raise-on-conflict semantics survive (now cross-thread-atomic).

THE FULL MIGRATION DESIGN IS cc-notes doc a6439b47 ("v14.3 fleet async-migration design") — read it first; it has the method-by-method mappings, the StoreSchema literals for both repos, the captain-hook async-boundary/daemon design (incl. the @cache footgun), test-conversion sketches, and the risk register. Orchestrator ruling recorded there: cc-steer's watch daemon uses tick(), not stream().

Summary: cc-steer (v13 async idioms — easy direction): subclass→composition on the async API; TRIAGE_DDL dies (engine renders it); views → extra_ddl; event_filter="e.quarantined_reason IS NULL"; +origin_path/+quarantined_reason via event_columns; platform unjudged paging replaces the local OFFSET copy; aiosqlite dropped; raw .store.conn access in 6 extra modules moves to store.sql/execute; watcher/daemon.py's deleted TailState/tick imports move to the platform Watcher. captain-hook: ASYNC END-TO-END (resident-daemon direction): review subsystem async throughout, bridge INVERTED (outer asyncio.run at run_event/run_store, nested asyncio.run→await), ReviewStore composes db: FeedbackStore + StoreSchema (6 tables extra_ddl, 7 ColumnMigrations, busy_timeout_ms passthrough), decision_writer thread gets one persistent loop, drop the @cache on open_decision_log/open_heartbeat_log, drop the events_seen test usage. Fleet test cleanup: cc-steer tests/test_formats.py regex_review_comments/group_value/int_group imports.

Pin >=14.5,<15 after the v14.5.0 release is live on PyPI. cc-sentiment and cc-context/bench: zero persistence-tier imports — no-ops.
